put.description: Updates delivery details in Shippify by ID or reference.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

deliveryIds[].description: Required array of up to 10 Shippify delivery identifiers to update.

referenceIds[].description: Optional array of delivery reference identifiers to update instead of delivery IDs.

deliveryChanges.description: Required object describing the delivery fields to update, such as dropoff, packages, tags, cod, or referenceId.

recalculatePrice.description: Whether Shippify should recalculate the delivery price after the update.

reorderRoute.description: Whether Shippify should reorder the route after the update when the delivery belongs to a route.

recalculateCity.description: Whether Shippify should recalculate the city after the update.

jobs.description: Additional job identifier when Shippify creates a background process.

items.description: Additional deliveries created by the update workflow when applicable.

reorderRoute.description: Whether Shippify should reorder the route after the update when the delivery belongs to a route.
